candidates.change_summary: Replace the increment with adding to a different mapping key (address(0)), causing balances at arbitrary keys to differ after Deposit.
Removed the check that prevents changing MinSum after initialization by deleting the revert guarded by intitalized, allowing MinSum to be changed at any time.
Inverted the initialization check so that MinSum can only be changed if intitalized is true (opposite of original behavior).
Added a requirement that the new MinSum must be at least 1 ether, preventing smaller values from being set.
Added a requirement that the new MinSum must be greater than the current MinSum, preventing decreases.
Changed assignment to double the provided value before storing, so MinSum is set to 2*_val instead of _val.
Prevented MinSum from ever being changed by making the function a no-op (assignment removed).
Removed the guard that prevents setting MinSum after initialization by deleting the revert check, allowing SetMinSum to update MinSum even when intitalized is true.
Invert the initialization guard so SetMinSum is only allowed after intitalized is true (revert when not initialized), changing when MinSum can be changed.
Change assignment to add the provided value to MinSum instead of overwriting it, so calling SetMinSum increases the stored MinSum cumulatively.
Negate the parameter when assigning so MinSum is set to the unsigned wrap of -_val (i.e., MaxUint - _val + 1), producing a very different stored MinSum for most inputs.
Make SetMinSum a no-op by removing the assignment, so calls no longer change MinSum (observable difference when original would have changed it).
Replace the conditional that prevents changing Log after initialization with the opposite check, allowing SetLogFile only when initialized is true (so post-Initialized behavior differs).
Remove the guard entirely so SetLogFile can always change Log regardless of initialization state.
Change the assignment to instead set Log to the zero address cast, preventing any caller from setting an arbitrary log address.
Make SetLogFile revert unconditionally, so the log can never be changed through this function.
Change the assignment to only allow the caller to set the Log to their own address (msg.sender) instead of the provided address.
